# IF-002 — Customer lookup

[Landscape and catalog](../../README.md) · [Catalog source](../../catalog/catalog.json)

Resolves a customer record while accepting an order.

## Authentication

OAuth 2.0 client credentials; scope customers:read.

## Reliability and failure handling

3-second timeout; retry 429 and transient 5xx with bounded backoff. Do not retry 404.

## Integration notes

- The arrow follows the HTTP request; the response travels back on the same connection.
